name: hackathon2026-bolzano-world
//: Deployment requirement: keep prebuild and postbuild. Vercel starts without the gitignored public/py files; prebuild generates them and postbuild verifies dist/py to prevent model-loading 404s.

scripts.data: uv run --no-project --python 3.11 --with openpyxl --with shapely --with pillow --with numpy --with pandas sh -c "python scripts/build_world.py && python scripts/build_details.py && python scripts/build_rails.py"
scripts.test:deployment: node --test scripts/test_model_assets.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_sync_model.py -v
scripts.test:data: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_rail_routes.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_drape.py'
scripts.pipeline: npm run model && npm run data && npm run test:model
scripts.replay: uv run --no-project --python 3.11 --with numpy --with scipy --with scikit-learn==1.9.1 python scripts/bake_search_replay.py
